_meta.note: KAS 0.66.33 run from Kiro Crew's OWN installed bundle (`kirocrew kas install`: `node --experimental-wasm-modules acp-server.js --transport=stdio --auth=acp-callback`, no kiro-cli anywhere on the recording PATH), driven over stdio by a scratch client that answered the engine's `_kiro/auth/getAccessToken` request from Crew's sign-in vault. Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, except: the session id is the fixed synthetic value kas-bundle-session-1, the scratch work dir reads as /work and the home directory as ~. The slice is the measurement for the model picker on this route: the initialize response, the engine's getAccessToken request (the one frame the bundle route adds, since Crew is the only credential owner there), the session/new response and the session/close response. The session/new response carries NO `models` object at all; the model list is the configOptions `model` select alone, and each option carries _meta.kiro rateMultiplier / rateUnit / hasEffort (and, on models with effort, effortLevels / effortSchemaPath / defaultEffortLevel / thinkingToggleable). No option carries a structured context-window field. The select is pruned to the product's own routing entry `auto` because the rest lists what the recording account is entitled to; the session/new `_meta` (the engine's session record: title, workspace paths, timestamps) is dropped, and modes.availableModes and the `mode` select keep only the entries marked _meta.kiro.source = bundled. Host inventory frames between the two responses (_kiro/mcp/status, _kiro/tools/didChange, _kiro/steering/documents_changed, _kiro/powers/items_changed, _kiro/sessions/changed, _kiro/governance/state, and the config_option_update / available_commands_update session updates) are omitted.
